title: Finite-data calculus for filtered colimits of infinity categories
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors, cores, mapping spaces, and nested universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$ as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], filteredness and finite simplicial sets as in [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and the infinity category $\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ of $\mathcal U$-small infinity categories as modeled in [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model]. Write $\mathcal S=\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ for the infinity category of $\mathcal U$-small spaces defined in [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Filtered means $\aleph_0$-filtered. Finite means having finitely many nondegenerate simplices. The infinity category $\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ admits small filtered colimits and finite limits. For every small filtered infinity category $I$, finite simplicial set $K$, and coherent diagram $F:K\times I\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$, the canonical comparison
$$\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}\lim_{k\in K}F(k,i)\longrightarrow\lim_{k\in K}\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}F(k,i)$$
is an equivalence, including $K=\varnothing$. For every diagram $D_i\to B$ to a fixed small infinity category and every functor $T\to B$, base change also satisfies $\operatorname{colim}_i(D_i\times_B T)\simeq(\operatorname{colim}_iD_i)\times_B T$, with the structural functor from the colimit induced by the given coherent maps to $B$. The core functor $(-)^{\simeq}:\operatorname{Cat}_\infty\to\mathcal S$ and, for each finite simplicial set $L$, the functor $\operatorname{Fun}(L,-):\operatorname{Cat}_\infty\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ preserve small filtered colimits.

More explicitly, let $D:I\to\operatorname{Cat}_\infty$ be a small filtered coherent diagram, let $C=\operatorname{colim}_I D$, and write $r_i:D_i\to C$ for its cocone. Every finite collection of objects and arrows in $C$, together with finitely many specified simplices among them, is represented up to coherent equivalence at a common stage. Given $x,y\in D_i$, the coherent coslice $I_{i/}$ of arrows out of $i$ is small and filtered, and the natural map
$$\operatorname{colim}_{(u:i\to j)\in I_{i/}}\operatorname{Map}_{D_j}(D(u)x,D(u)y)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{C}(r_ix,r_iy)$$
is an equivalence. These comparisons are natural in the objects, in precomposition and postcomposition, and under a coherent diagram of functors $D_i\to B$ to a fixed small infinity category $B$. For such a diagram and an arrow $f:p_i(x)\to p_i(y)$ in $B$, they also give the equivalence on homotopy fibers
$$\operatorname{colim}_{(u:i\to j)\in I_{i/}}\operatorname{Map}_{D_j}^{f}(D(u)x,D(u)y)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{C}^{f}(r_ix,r_iy),$$
where the superscript $f$ denotes the homotopy fiber of the map to $\operatorname{Map}_B(p_i(x),p_i(y))$. No transition functor is assumed fully faithful.
